entities.name: Uno Öhrlund
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Uno Öhrlund is a Swedish retired ice hockey player who won a silver medal at the 1964 Winter Olympics. Between 1957 and 1965 he played 85 times with the Sweden national team and scored 57 goals. He won a world title in 1962, finishing second in 1963 and third in 1965.
